ActionDescriptions.ToAddFFmpegTextOverlayArtifact:
to add text overlay to video artifact with ffmpeg
sourceVideoPath - input video.
overlayText - text to burn into top-left corner.
outputFileName/tempDirectory/sessionDirectory/ffmpegPath/ffprobePath - output and tool paths.
ActionDescriptions.ToCompressFFmpegVideoArtifact:
to compress video artifact with ffmpeg
sourceVideoPath - input video.
crf - H.264 quality value; 23 balanced, higher is smaller.
maxWidth - optional max width; use 0 to preserve.
outputFileName/tempDirectory/sessionDirectory/ffmpegPath/ffprobePath - output and tool paths.
ActionDescriptions.ToCreateFFmpegContactSheetArtifact:
to create video contact sheet artifact with ffmpeg
sourceVideoPath - input video.
fps - sampling rate such as 1 for one frame per second.
columns - tile columns.
rows - tile rows; use at least 1.
outputFileName/tempDirectory/sessionDirectory/ffmpegPath - output and tool paths.
ActionDescriptions.ToExtractFFmpegAudioArtifact:
to separate the audio track from a video artifact
sourceMediaPath - video/media source as a local path, session artifact path, semantic file ref path, or approved https URL.
outputFileName - target audio artifact name. Use .m4a for the default AAC audio/mp4 output.
tempDirectory/sessionDirectory - working directory and session root/artifact root. Output is staged under artifacts/audio.
ffmpegPath/ffprobePath - optional tool paths. Defaults to C:\ffmpeg\bin.
Extracts the first source audio stream to AAC m4a, validates with ffprobe before and after extraction, and never mutates the source media.
ActionDescriptions.ToExtractFFmpegVideoThumbnailArtifact:
to extract video thumbnail artifact with ffmpeg
sourceVideoPath - input video.
timestampSeconds - frame timestamp.
outputFileName - image artifact name, usually .jpg or .png.
tempDirectory/sessionDirectory - output locations.
ffmpegPath - optional ffmpeg.exe path.
ActionDescriptions.ToFinalizeFFmpegMkvRecordingArtifact:
to convert a safe ffmpeg live recording to a preview artifact
sourceMkvPath - completed or interrupted-safe MKV recording.
outputFileName - target .mp4 artifact name.
tempDirectory/sessionDirectory - output locations.
ffmpegPath/ffprobePath - optional tool paths.
Remuxes an MKV recording into browser-previewable MP4, copies both the MP4 and MKV source into the session directory, validates the MP4, and returns semantic file refs.
ActionDescriptions.ToGetFFmpegVersion:
to verify ffmpeg is installed
ffmpegPath - optional absolute path to ffmpeg.exe. Defaults to C:\ffmpeg\bin\ffmpeg.exe.
ActionDescriptions.ToInspectPdfPagesForContentAndClipping:
to detect PDF pages with missing content
pdfFilePath - absolute path to the PDF file. pythonPath - optional Python executable; defaults to python on PATH. Uses PyMuPDF to return read-only JSON with page dimensions, text counts, image counts, and image bounds. Fails explicitly when Python, PyMuPDF, or the PDF is unavailable.
ActionDescriptions.ToNormalizeFFmpegVideoForWebArtifact:
to normalize video for web playback with ffmpeg
sourceVideoPath - input video.
outputFileName - browser-safe MP4 artifact name.
tempDirectory/sessionDirectory - output locations.
ffmpegPath/ffprobePath - optional tool paths.
Converts to H.264 MP4 yuv420p with even dimensions and validates output.
ActionDescriptions.ToProbeFFmpegMediaFile:
to validate a video artifact
filePath - media file to inspect.
ffprobePath - optional absolute path to ffprobe.exe. Defaults to C:\ffmpeg\bin\ffprobe.exe.
Returns ffprobe JSON for duration, size, and streams.
ActionDescriptions.ToReconstructVisualStoryFromRawVideo:
to distill messy screen recordings into a product demo
Workflow for reconstructing a concise visual story from raw videos by generating timestamped contact sheets, mapping visible events, cutting non-story footage, selecting proof beats, aligning captions to visible evidence, stitching clips into a narrative MP4/GIF, and validating outputs.
ActionDescriptions.ToRecordFFmpegBrowserDemoArtifact:
to record browser demo video artifact with ffmpeg
url - URL to open before/during recording.
durationSeconds - recording length.
outputFileName/tempDirectory/sessionDirectory/overlayText/ffmpegPath/ffprobePath - same as ToRecordFFmpegDesktopVideoArtifact.
This FFmpeg-specific action records the desktop while launching a browser URL for simple Buffaly demos.
ActionDescriptions.ToRecordFFmpegDesktopVideoArtifact:
to record desktop video artifact with ffmpeg
durationSeconds - recording length.
outputFileName - target .mp4 file name.
tempDirectory - working output directory.
sessionDirectory - current session artifact directory.
openUrl - optional URL to open at recording start.
overlayText - optional text burned into the video.
ffmpegPath - optional absolute path to ffmpeg.exe.
ffprobePath - optional absolute path to ffprobe.exe.
Records the desktop with gdigrab into an interruption-tolerant MKV working file first, finalizes a browser-safe MP4, copies verified artifacts into the session directory, validates with ffprobe, and returns semantic file refs.
ActionDescriptions.ToTrimFFmpegVideoArtifact:
to trim video artifact with ffmpeg
sourceVideoPath - input video.
startSeconds - start time.
durationSeconds - clip length.
outputFileName/tempDirectory/sessionDirectory/ffmpegPath/ffprobePath - output and tool paths.
